course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Conditions: choose an action and check boundaries
goal: Build a decision table for a known numeric input and test branch ordering and boundaries.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: State the rule first
paragraphs: A condition has a Boolean answer, Истина or Ложь. Reject quantities below zero or above 1440 first. Among valid inputs distinguish zero, then quantities up to and including 60. The input is already known to be numeric; arbitrary text parsing is outside this rule.

Partition numeric inputs into four disjoint classes: outside 0..1440; exactly 0; 1..60; and above 60 up to 1440. This guides branches and boundaries. The main exercise assumes numeric type; do not promise string-input validation the source does not perform.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: The invalid-range test is false; the zero test is true and selects the branch.

code.output: For Минуты = 0 the message is “Без затрат”.

sections.title: The first matching branch
paragraphs: An Если/ИначеЕсли/Иначе chain chooses its first matching branch. Testing zero before <=60 preserves “Без затрат” (no time spent). With the range first, zero would already select “Короткая” (short), preventing the later zero branch.

Each branch assigns text to Класс; one message follows КонецЕсли. Later ИначеЕсли branches do not revise the chosen value. A trace includes tests that were never reached, explaining why order matters.

sections.title: And, or and negation
paragraphs: Или is true when at least one of the two limits is violated. A negative quantity and exceeding the upper limit are different invalid cases. Replacing Или with И is wrong: no number is simultaneously below zero and above 1440.

A И B requires both conditions; A Или B requires at least one; Не negates a Boolean. For a complex expression evaluate simple parts first, then combine them. Use parentheses to make intention explicit rather than depending on guessed precedence.

sections.title: The short-request boundary
paragraphs: 61 is valid, nonzero and no longer <=60.

code.source: Минуты = 61; // keep the rest of the chain unchanged

sections.title: A boundary counterexample
paragraphs: Test where the answer changes: -1/0, 0/1, 60/61 and 1440/1441. Input 30 alone cannot expose a missing boundary. Record which preceding conditions are false and which becomes true. This explains the branch rather than guessing from the final message.

Accidental <60 instead of <=60 fails at 60 while input 30 hides the error. Removing the upper rejection may classify 1441 as long. For each suspected mutation choose an input on which correct and incorrect programs differ.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Zero is <=60, so ordering is irrelevant. The chain selects its first matching branch.
И and Или are interchangeable. Simultaneous conditions differ from at least one condition.

selfcheck.prompt: What does the shown chain select for 0?
Why is “Минуты < 0 И Минуты > 1440” unsuitable for rejection?
options: A number cannot violate both limits simultaneously
selfcheck.feedback: One violated limit suffices, so use Или.

selfcheck.prompt: Which inputs best expose a wrong inclusive boundary at 60?
selfcheck.feedback: Adjacent values lie on opposite sides of the boundary.

selfcheck.prompt: Find counterexamples to replacing Или with И and moving <=60 before zero.
selfcheck.feedback: -1/1441 exposes the wrong connective; 0 exposes wrong ordering.

practice.externalRoute: Designer → managed application module of your training copy

steps.title: Predict the result
steps.action: Make a decision table for 0, 60 and 61 before execution.
steps.why: An expectation makes a wrong result detectable.
steps.expected: For Минуты = 0 the message is “Без затрат”.
steps.troubleshooting: Use the trace to separate each instruction; do not copy a displayed total without explaining it.
steps.before: Your own training infobase opens and its startup handler already works. Preserve the preceding source before replacing this exercise body.

steps.title: Preserve your preceding work
steps.where: Your infobase → Designer → configuration root → managed application module
steps.action: Close only your own Enterprise session. Open your training copy in Designer. Preserve the previous module text separately. Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler; replace only the preceding exercise body inside it. Do not replace modules of an unfamiliar application.
steps.why: The next exercise must not destroy the preceding version.
steps.expected: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.
steps.troubleshooting: If you cannot identify the infobase, return to the startup list and check its entry and directory.
steps.before: For Минуты = 0 the message is “Без затрат”.

steps.title: Enter this example
steps.action: Copy the main example between the existing handler declaration and КонецПроцедуры. Do not add another handler. Read the explanation and identify what changes after each line.
steps.why: The invalid-range test is false; the zero test is true and selects the branch.
steps.expected: The exact exercise source is entered in the intended context.
steps.troubleshooting: Check ordinary quotes, semicolons and matching block endings. A syntax rejection is not execution.
steps.before: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.

steps.title: Save, update and execute
steps.where: Designer → Ctrl+S → Configuration / Update database configuration (F7) → Debug / Start (F5)
steps.action: Save your source, complete the database update and start Enterprise mode. Read the message area and compare each actual output with your prediction.
steps.why: Only the installed platform executes this BSL.
steps.expected: For Минуты = 0 the message is “Без затрат”.
steps.troubleshooting: For old output close your client, verify the infobase and update again. For a different value find the first trace step that differs.
steps.before: The exact exercise source is entered in the intended context.

steps.title: Change one condition and retain evidence
steps.where: The same module, then Enterprise mode and Nexus notes
steps.action: Change the input to 60, 61, -1 and 1441 in turn. Execute each version and compare with the table.
steps.why: A changed input tests understanding beyond copying the example.
steps.troubleshooting: For a different result, preserve the failed version and find the first incorrect condition. Do not change the requirement to fit the output.
steps.before: For Минуты = 0 the message is “Без затрат”.
